description: Compare the lowest one-way or round-trip fare for each departure date across 1 to 31 dates. Every date is checked and returned with a price or no_price status. Follow up with search_flights on the chosen date(s) for bookable itineraries.

end.description: Last departure date to check (YYYY-MM-DD), inclusive; 1 to 31 dates total.
end.title: End

TimeRangeInput.description: Inclusive airport-local hour bounds; the full latest hour is included.

arrival_earliest_hour.description: Earliest arrival hour (0-23, destination airport local time).
arrival_earliest_hour.title: Arrival Earliest Hour

arrival_latest_hour.description: Latest arrival hour (0-23, destination airport local time; full hour included).
arrival_latest_hour.title: Arrival Latest Hour

earliest_hour.description: Earliest departure hour (0-23, origin airport local time).
earliest_hour.title: Earliest Hour

latest_hour.description: Latest departure hour (0-23, origin airport local time; full hour included).
latest_hour.title: Latest Hour

TimeRangeInput.title: TimeRangeInput

adults.description: Number of adult passengers (1+). Max 9 total passengers.
adults.title: Adults

cabin_class.description: Preferred cabin class: economy, premium_economy, business, or first.
cabin_class.title: Cabin Class

carry_on_bags.description: Requested total carry-on bags for the party, up to one per traveler with a seat. Zero, null or omitted means no preference. Calendar returns date-level prices.
carry_on_bags.title: Carry On Bags

checked_bags.description: Requested total checked bags for the party, up to one per traveler with a seat. Zero, null or omitted means no preference.
checked_bags.title: Checked Bags

departure_date_range.description: Inclusive departure date window spanning 1 to 31 dates.

departure_time_range.description: Optional outbound departure and arrival local hour bounds.

destination.description: 3-letter IATA destination airport or metro code (e.g. LON, JFK).
destination.title: Destination

infants_in_seat.description: Number of infants with their own seat.
infants_in_seat.title: Infants In Seat

infants_on_lap.description: Number of lap infants (cannot exceed adults).
infants_on_lap.title: Infants On Lap

market.description: 2-letter country code affecting pricing currency and locale (e.g. US, GB).
market.title: Market

max_price.description: Maximum whole-trip price in the selected market currency.
max_price.title: Max Price

max_stops.description: Maximum number of stops in each direction (0 for nonstop, 1, or 2).
max_stops.title: Max Stops

origin.description: 3-letter IATA origin airport or metro code (e.g. NYC, SFO).
origin.title: Origin

return_time_range.description: Optional return departure and arrival local hour bounds (requires stay_days).

stay_days.description: Omit for one-way. For round trips, return this many days after each departure.
stay_days.title: Stay Days

name: search_cheapest_dates

price.description: Lowest qualifying whole-trip fare for the party. Null when the search found no qualifying quote.

status.description: A priced date has a qualifying fare. A no_price date was checked and had no qualifying quote.
status.title: Status

observed_at.description: UTC time Ignav finished retrieving these prices; null when unknown. Not a guarantee of current fares.
observed_at.title: Observed At

title: Search cheapest dates
